Exhibit 13.1
 
CERTIFICATION
 
Pursuant to 18 U.S.C. Section 1350, as adopted pursuant to Section 906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, each of the undersigned officers of Toyota Motor Corporation, a Japanese corporation (the “Company“), does hereby certify that, to such officer’s knowledge:
 
1. The Annual Report of the Company on Form 20-F for the period ended March 31, 2010, as amended by the accompanying Amendment No. 2 on Form 20-F/A (the “Report“) fully complies with the requirements of Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934; and
 
2. Information contained in the Report fairly presents, in all material respects, the financial condition and results of operations of the Company.
